task: Two-by-two RUL ablation of estimated-background subtraction and additional training augmentation
reference_model: Existing fit_reference: target median/MAD scaling, context StandardScaler and Ridge(alpha=10), fit on earlier candidate-normal replay blocks only
auxiliary_source: rul_balanced_training_v1/auxiliary_data: reuse fixed 36 combinations per RUL-fit background; no regeneration
features: Same 125 current/24/96 mean/change features; optionally replace 12 observed target channels with residuals from the frozen earlier-background model
fit_control: Within augmentation status, raw/residual have identical fit keys and labels; augmented adds only existing auxiliary scenes on RUL-fit backgrounds
evaluation_control: All variants use unchanged prior RUL outer-evaluation keys; all eligible short-life points and zero endpoints retained
primary_metric: scene-macro RMSE hours; seed mean within fold, then equal fold mean
contrasts: Paired background effect at each augmentation level, paired augmentation effect at each background level, and difference-of-differences interaction
scope: No sample weighting, 225-feature trends, LSTM, hyperparameter search, interval recalibration or automatic delivery promotion
limitations: Main and auxiliary amplitude statistics were fixed from all Jan-Jun backgrounds
Training backgrounds and older augmentation experiments have already been observed
Augmentation changes sample amount and mixture; this experiment does not isolate a pure sample-count effect
Evaluation keys match the prior baseline but RUL fitting uses fewer blocks because earlier blocks are reserved for reference estimation
